description: Records the user's rating of a finished order, positive or negative, with an optional comment and list of issues. Our team is told. A second rating for the same order replaces the first, comment included.

api_key.description: Barevalue API key (bv_sk_...), as returned by barevalue_register. Not needed when the connection already sends an Authorization: Bearer header.

comment.description: Optional: what the user said, in the user's own words (max 2000 characters)

rating.description: Whether the user is happy with the edit

name: barevalue_feedback
title: Rate an edit
